description: This file defines functions and a class object for handling Discord configuration validation, normalization, and repair within a larger plugin SDK. It includes logic for processing IDs, allowlists, and configuration migration.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise null.

methods.name: sanitizeForLog
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for logging by replacing control characters with spaces.

methods.name: isDiscordMutableAllowEntry
methods.description: Checks if a string is a mutable allowlist entry for Discord, excluding mentions and certain prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordDmAliases
methods.description: Normalizes Discord direct message alias configuration, migrating legacy fields to new structure.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordStreamingAliases
methods.description: Normalizes streaming configuration, migrating legacy streamMode to streaming and resolving values.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the entire Discord section of the configuration, including Dm and streaming aliases.

methods.name: collectDiscordAccountScopes
methods.description: Collects scope information for Discord accounts from the configuration.

methods.name: collectDiscordIdLists
methods.description: Collects references to ID lists within a Discord account configuration.

methods.name: scanDiscordNumericIdEntries
methods.description: Scans the configuration for numeric Discord IDs and returns hits with safety info.

methods.name: collectDiscordNumericIdWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings about numeric IDs that should be quoted as strings.

methods.name: maybeRepairDiscordNumericIds
methods.description: Attempts to repair numeric Discord IDs by converting them to strings, with warnings.

methods.name: collectDiscordMutableAllowlistWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings about mutable allowlist entries that are potentially dangerous.
